request.style: English, male rock voice with backing choir, electric guitar, bass guitar, drums, organ, urgent and triumphant mood, 120 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The boat is tossed upon the deep
The waves are rising, fierce and steep
Disciples wake the sleeping man
Lord, save us from the storming span

[Chorus]
Why are you afraid, you of little faith
He rebuked the winds, He stilled the sway
The sea obeyed His mighty word
A great calm came to shore

[Verse]
They watched Him rise with power unseen
The violent wind was driven clean
The sea lay still under His command
No longer fearing where they stand

[Chorus]
Why are you afraid, you of little faith
He rebuked the winds, He stilled the sway
The sea obeyed His mighty word
A great calm came to shore

[Bridge]
What kind of man is this they say
The winds and sea obey His way
Amazed by the power He displays
In the heart of the raging days

[Chorus]
Why are you afraid, you of little faith
He rebuked the winds, He stilled the sway
The sea obeyed His mighty word
A great calm came to shore

[Outro]
Even the sea obeys His name
His power remains the same
